title: Dipole orientation-induced interfacial energy level alignment difference in 2D perovskite passivated 3D perovskite by in situ investigation
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,3831-3837
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00459D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ruifeng Zheng, Jielei Li, Shengwen Li, Bingchen He, Shi Chen
BAI and BDAI are deposited on the perovskite surface with different energy level alignments. BAI forms a favorable alignment for electron transfer, while BDAI molecules form an additional interfacial dipole that impairs the electron transfer process.
